flavor: The air here is thick with the scent of pulverized flint and ancient dust. Massive, jagged pillars of obsidian rise from a floor of shifting shale, vibrating with a low, rhythmic thrum that rattles the teeth.
name: The Lithic Crucible
reason: A concentrated cluster of earth elementals guards a narrow choke point, forcing the party into a high-stakes skirmish within a cramped, uneven terrain.
